name: Launcher
summary: Open apps, settings and files, and get quick answers, from one search
description: Fills Ledge's launcher: type to open an app, a page of System Settings or a file in your home folder, or get an answer straight away, a sum, a tip, a unit conversion or the time in another city. Searching runs on this Mac. With your own API key for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible server, an Ask AI row answers questions in the launcher; a question is sent only when you choose that row.
author: Ledge
